CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(p_txkey integer)
RETURNS numeric AS $$
SELECT AVG(
    CASE (therapy_details->>'engagement')
        WHEN 'High' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
        ELSE 0
    END
)::numeric
)
FROM treatmentbasics
WHERE txkey = p_txkey;
$$ LANGUAGE SQL;
